items.title: FAA Order: First Class Passengers Will No Longer Be Able To Sip Beverages After Pushback
items.summary: After 35 years since the law was imposed, the Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) will now mandate that passengers will not be permitted to hold onto provided service items, such as paper and plastic cups, during pushback. As first reported by View From The Wing, this will result in less time for pre-departure beverages typically served in premium cabins.

items.title: Why Air Canada Chose the A350 Over the 777X
items.summary: In this video, we'll look at why Air Canada selected up to 16 Airbus A350-1000s over Boeing's delayed 777X, what the aircraft offers that the 777-9 currently can't, and why this decision could signal a much broader shift in how airlines plan their future long-haul fleets.

items.title: 肯定台灣發展無人機 華爾街日報籲川普推進對台軍售
items.summary: （中央社華盛頓1日綜合外電報導）「華爾街日報」主筆室撰文指出，台灣近期積極推動無人機發展意義重大，如今關鍵在於美國總統川普是否會為這個模範盟友提供更多武器支援；文章呼籲美方加強與台灣合作生產無人機，並推進對台軍售案。
